title: The relationship one decision record carries
lede: One policy-decision-log record holds all four parts of requirement 9. Data.RequestID ties the decision to the approval hold that follows it. Pick a record to fill the boxes with its values.

steps.title: a · the user
steps.what: Data.User names the user the call was made for; Data.PrincipalKind says whether it is a person (User) or a workload (NonHumanIdentity).

steps.title: b · the agent
steps.what: Data.AgentKey names the agent access key the call came in with. A call that carried the user's own token has no agent key, so nothing names the agent.

steps.title: c · the tool
steps.what: Data.Target is the tool, Data.Method the MCP method (tools/call) and Data.App the MCP app it was called on.

steps.title: d · the decision
steps.what: Data.Decision (deny, hitl, allow), Data.Reason and Data.PolicyIDs: what the policy said and which policy said it. The approval hold that follows carries the same Data.RequestID (dashed: a separate record).
